candidates.title: Westlink Back Path community park and sports zone officially opened
candidates.summary: The Department for Communities recorded the official opening of a community park and sports zone at the Westlink Back Path in Belfast on 24 November 2021.
candidates.observed_change: A renovated strip of land beside the Westlink entered documented public use with a running track, gym, multi-use games area, play equipment, seating, a community garden, and improved access ramp.
candidates.source_name: Minister Hargey officially opens new community park and sports zone at Westlink Back Path in Belfast
candidates.project_type: community park, sports zone, and public-realm upgrade
candidates.geometry_source: Curated approximate point for the Westlink Back Path / Lower Shankill corridor described by the source.
candidates.geometry_precision: Approximate corridor point, not a measured park boundary, ramp, MUGA, garden, or play-area footprint.

candidates.limitations: The source documents official opening and main facilities; it does not provide surveyed geometry, construction-start dates, or a full maintenance record.
